name: DROWL Layouts for Bootstrap
project_description: DROWL Layouts for Bootstrap ships a set of Bootstrap-5-grid section layouts as Layout Discovery layout plugins, for use with Layout Builder and Layout Paragraphs. It is the Bootstrap-based sibling of the older Foundation-based DROWL Layouts and is the module DROWL recommends for new sites. It defines column layouts (1-6 columns, plain and stacked variants), component layouts (Card and Media object), a node-detail page layout, a multi-row Row Layout and a CSS-grid Dynamic Content Grid. Per-section controls (container width, Bootstrap gutter classes, flex alignment, per-region responsive column widths and free custom classes) are supplied through the Layout Options module, which most layouts delegate to via the LayoutOptions plugin class. It depends on core Layout Discovery, Twig Real Content (for accurate empty-region detection in previews) and Layout Options. The module ships only Twig templates, CSS libraries and admin styling; it contains no PHP classes, routes or services of its own, and works best with a Bootstrap 5 theme (e.g. Radix).
